excerpt: Fieldwork occurred in 2021 (May 24-August 19, with 13 personnel), 2022 (May 9-August 15, with 15 personnel), and 2023 (limited fieldwork with 1 person); array is a 1.25 km grid of stations with three strings of 15 antennas 100 m below the surface and 9 surface antennas.
title: Radio Neutrino Observatory in Greenland — Summit Station research projects
